name: v240_cost_aqi_anti_gross_residual
hypothesis: Operating cost discipline plus acquisition income contribution may be useful, but direct gross-income guidance is already crowded; subtracting that sleeve should leave a cleaner residual.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (fnd6_newqv1300_cogsq + fnd6_newqv1300_xoprq) / abs(sales), 126), industry) + 0.210 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_wdpq)), 126), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_aqi / assets, 126), industry) - 0.240 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_grossincome_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_grossincome_maxguidance) / (2 * sales), 63), 126), industry) + 0.110 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)

name: v240_backlog_cost_anti_gross_model
hypothesis: Backlog conversion and cost discipline should reward real demand absorption; a small model-quality term may stabilize it while a gross-guidance subtraction reduces old guidance exposure.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.300 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(vec_avg(fnd6_obs), 252) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.210 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (fnd6_newqv1300_cogsq + fnd6_newqv1300_xoprq) / abs(sales), 126), industry) - 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_grossincome_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_grossincome_maxguidance) / (2 * sales), 63), 126), industry) + 0.130 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fscore_surface_accel, 126), industry) + 0.100 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)

name: v240_model_cost_anti_gross_no_option
hypothesis: Model contrarian quality without option/news sleeves is weak alone, but may become useful as a residual confirmer for cost discipline after subtracting gross-income guidance crowding.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.240 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fscore_surface_accel, 126), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_value, 126), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (fnd6_newqv1300_cogsq + fnd6_newqv1300_xoprq) / abs(sales), 126), industry) - 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_grossincome_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_grossincome_maxguidance) / (2 * sales), 63), 126), industry) + 0.100 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(returns * (volume / adv20), 10)), -1)

name: v240_contract_receivable_cost_residual
hypothesis: Deferred revenue growth is occupied, but pairing it with low receivables and cost discipline while subtracting gross-income guidance may test a billing-to-cost conversion residual rather than a pure backlog sibling.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(fnd6_drc + fnd6_drlt, 252) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.190 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * receivable / sales, 126), subindustry) + 0.190 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (fnd6_newqv1300_cogsq + fnd6_newqv1300_xoprq) / abs(sales), 126), industry) - 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_grossincome_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_grossincome_maxguidance) / (2 * sales), 63), 126), industry) + 0.140 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)

name: v240_workingcapital_cash_cost_residual
hypothesis: Non-cost working-capital restraint plus cash-income conversion may be a different expansion of the cost-conversion parent, provided it avoids the old backlog/inventory and gross-guidance exposures.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.250 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(fnd6_newqv1300_wcapq / abs(assets), 252), 126), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newa1v1300_ibc / abs(fnd6_newqv1300_cogsq + fnd6_newqv1300_xoprq), 126), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (fnd6_newqv1300_cogsq + fnd6_newqv1300_xoprq) / abs(sales), 126), industry) - 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_grossincome_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_grossincome_maxguidance) / (2 * sales), 63), 126), industry) + 0.130 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)
